kyklos-bridge: the Kyklos Bridge, the local service that runs builds, tests and project tools for the agent.

The Bridge is normally started by the Kyklos Launcher, which gives it its settings. Run it by hand only to wire a
project yourself; its settings (port, solution, settings file) are described in the installation and
configuration guide that comes with Kyklos.

Usage:
  kyklos-bridge [settings]                                  start the Bridge
  kyklos-bridge resource-hold <key> <seconds>               hold one host resource lock for a time (diagnostic)
  kyklos-bridge coverage-verdict <label>=<cobertura.xml>... print the coverage verdict of labelled cobertura files
  kyklos-bridge reuse-hit-rate <repository> <trunk-ref> [count]
                                                            print how many tokens the reuse rule would keep
  kyklos-bridge --help | -h | -? | /?                       print this text
  kyklos-bridge --version                                   print the version

result.stderr: [kyklos-bridge] REFUSING TO START: bound to 127.0.0.1,172.17.0.1:5555 with NO authentication (KYKLOS_BRIDGE_AUTH_TOKEN is unset). This open-and-unauthenticated posture lets any peer that can reach the address run tests/builds, copy files, and kill processes on this host = remote code execution / file exfil / DoS (CWE-306 / CWE-1327). Provision KYKLOS_BRIDGE_AUTH_TOKEN, or bind loopback (KYKLOS_BRIDGE_BIND=127.0.0.1). To temporarily revert to warn-only, set KYKLOS_BRIDGE_REQUIRE_AUTH=off.
